title: Output prefix under computation
statement: Let $H$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$, and let $p$ be a Boolean word. For every $t\in\mathbb N$, starting the machine from the configuration obtained by prefixing the output of $c$ with $p$ gives the same result as running from $c$ and then prefixing the resulting output with $p$; all other components of the final configuration agree.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean word used as the output prefix
